<b>Cling Grip</b> is an [[Abilities (Silksong)|Ability]] that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] acquires in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. With it, Hornet can climb up vertical walls, enabling access to several new areas and items. It functions similarly to the [[Mantis Claw]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>.

== Function ==
When pressing against a vertical wall, Hornet briefly sticks to the surface before slowly sliding down. Downsliding can be prevented with the [[Ascendant's Grip]] tool by holding the directional movement button that goes towards the wall.
* While clinging to a wall, press JUMP to launch off the wall.
* Move in the direction of the wall while repeatedly pressing JUMP to climb up the wall.
* While clinging to a wall and pressing LEFT/RIGHT up against the wall, press SPRINT to climb the wall vertically.

Cling Grip is necessary to complete some platforming segments of the game. 

== How to Acquire ==
Cling Grip can be found in a [[Weaver Burial Spire]] in [[Shellwood]], past a platforming section, which can be accessed after defeating [[Sister Splinter]] in the room to the right.
